info.title: Shared Data Models for Fourletters API
info.description: Shared data models for the fourletters.

token.description: The identity token provided by the third-party OAuth provider.

roles.description: List of user permissions/roles for RBAC.

messageId.description: Unique identifier for the message generated by the client

senderId.description: ID of the sender user. Set by the Server from the authenticated session at send time; any client-provided value is ignored. Omitted in the send request.

seq.description: Per-recipient monotonic sequence number assigned by the Server on accept. Present on delivered/inbox messages; omitted in the send request.

signature.description: Detached signature over the payload produced by the sender's identity key (Base64). Verified end-to-end by the recipient against the public-key directory.

messageId.description: ID of the accepted message (echoed from the request).

seq.description: Per-recipient sequence number assigned by the Server.

status.description: The Server has durably taken ownership of the message.

messages.description: Undelivered messages with seq greater than the requested 'since', ordered by seq ascending.

lastSeq.description: Highest sequence number the Server has accepted for this recipient. Lets the client detect gaps versus what it received live.

messageId.description: ID of the message being acknowledged.

type.description: 'delivered' = the recipient device received and decrypted it; 'read' = the user opened it.

signature.description: Signature over (messageId, type) by the recipient's identity key (Base64). Lets the Server and the original sender trust the receipt without trusting any Hub.

messageId.description: ID of the original message this receipt refers to.

recipientId.description: ID of the user who delivered/read the message (the original recipient).

MessageEvent.description: WS push: a new encrypted message relayed live by the Hub.

ReceiptEvent.description: WS push: a delivery/read notification relayed live to the original sender.
